Describe the religious policies of the Umayyads.
You should refer to Fig. 1.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘The Umayyads left a legacy of good interfaith relations.’ Do you agree?
You should refer to different points of view.

Describe the contribution made by one famous scientist under the ʿAbbasid caliphate.
You should refer to Fig. 2.1 and your own knowledge in your answer.

parts.label: (b)

‘The ʿAbbasid scientists laid the foundation of modern science.’ Do you agree?
You should refer to different points of view.

parts.text: Describe how Islamic beliefs and values are expressed in one significant writing.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate how one significant work written by a Muslim might help others to understand more
about Islamic beliefs. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how Islamic art differs from that of pre-Islamic Arabia.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Muslims should embrace different cultural expressions of Islam through art.’
Do you agree? You should refer to different points of view.
